Name: Guinea Pig Cage (Crib Replacement)
Author: novac4real
Description:
Replace the default baby crib in your farmhouse with a cozy, detailed guinea pig cage! Perfect for farmers who prefer tiny furry companions over toddlers.

Apply the mode only if you have 2 children, or one and you are not going to have another one, and you need to have the crib in the house.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51709/51709-1788518245-712260974.jpg[/img]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces the vanilla baby crib with a custom guinea pig cage design.[/*]
[*]Completely removes the front wooden crib bars and base frame for a clean look.[/*]
[*]Light on performance, fully standalone Content Patcher pack.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the
[code][CP] Guinea Pig Cage[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Paste the extracted folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI and enjoy![/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Extract this in Mods folder. Be sure you have ContentPatcher
